name: kci.job
doc: A container that runs to completion, as its own identity, started on a schedule or by whatever is granted CALL on it. `job` (a container_job) runs as `account` (a service_account); `timer` (a schedule that starts `job`) exists only when `cron` is set. Both are exported: grant to `account` to let the job reach a resource, and grant CALL on `job` to let another identity start a run.

input.name: image
input.doc: What the job runs: a build step's output or a digest.

input.name: cron
input.doc: When a run starts (Schedule.cron). Unset: no schedule; a run starts only when an identity granted CALL on `job` starts one.

input.name: timezone
input.doc: The time zone `cron` is read in (Schedule.timezone). Unset: UTC. Read only when `cron` is set.

input.name: max_retries
input.doc: How many times a failed run is retried (ContainerJob.max_retries). Unset: the versioned default.

input.name: env
input.doc: The job's environment: plain values, each a literal, a parameter or another resource's output.
